title: Canapé-Vert barricade protest against a proposed departmental delegate appointment
threshold_50_evidence: No participant count or qualitative threshold estimate in either body; ≥50 unknown. Do not infer attendance from multiple streets.

occurrence.summary: Le National reports barricades/roadblocks in Canapé-Vert on 4 Dec; Haiti Standard reports residents protesting and erecting barricades in Canapé-Vert on the same morning.

start_date.summary: Both reports date action to 4 December 2024.

organizer.summary: Residents are identified; no formal organizing group is named.

participants.summary: No number or qualitative crowd description provided.

threshold_50.summary: Unknown; no evidence that 50 or more were present simultaneously at one gathering.

state_target.summary: Haiti Standard residents opposed possible appointment to the West delegation; Le National reports demands that the CPT/government act against insecurity. The issue relationship between these reports is not resolved.

demands.summary: Appointment of a departmental authority and calls for state action are domestic political/governance demands.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; barricades are reported, but the accounts do not establish violence by protesters against the state.

state_response.summary: Unknown; no direct official response to this action is described.

end_date.summary: Unknown; only the morning of 4 December is described.

notes: Possible overlap between two same-date reports: Haiti Standard gives an appointment grievance; Le National frames same-area barricades as security demands and also lists other neighborhoods. Keep event scope local to Canapé-Vert pending review; no neighborhood counts combined. Le National URL redirected automatically and its destination assessment was post-retrieval only; see source card and deviation record.
open_questions: Were the two Canapé-Vert accounts describing the same barricades, distinct gatherings, or multiple motivations among one group?
How many people were present simultaneously at any one Canapé-Vert gathering?
Was there a response or did the protest end on 4 December?
Does barricade construction correspond to a public gathering of at least 50, or are residents dispersed?

title: Reported security-related roadblocks in other metropolitan Port-au-Prince neighborhoods
location: Christ-Roi, Delmas 32, Nazon and other metropolitan Port-au-Prince routes; precise site list incomplete
organizer: Local residents, as reported by Le National
threshold_50_evidence: No site-specific counts. Do not add separate neighborhood populations or infer a simultaneous threshold.

occurrence.summary: Le National reports roadblocks on several routes in the metro area and specifically mentions Christ-Roi, Delmas 32 and Nazon.

location.summary: Body names several neighborhoods/routes but does not map each blockade or specify the total sites.

organizer.summary: The article attributes the roadblocks to members of the population/residents; no organizer named.

participants.summary: No number or qualitative attendance estimate per location.

threshold_50.summary: Unknown at any individual gathering; cannot aggregate multiple routes.

state_target.summary: Residents are reported demanding urgent measures from authorities, criticizing CPT/government inaction and calling for action against insecurity.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; roadblocks are described; violence by participants is not established.

state_response.summary: Unknown; no response to the blockades reported.

end_date.summary: Unknown; body describes morning conditions only.

notes: Do not merge with Canapé-Vert or call this one national episode until evidence clarifies coordination and site/event boundaries. The roadblocks may be connected; no separate event count inferred.
open_questions: Were other neighborhood roadblocks separate meetings or one coordinated episode?
Did any one site have at least 50 participants simultaneously?
How does this lead overlap with the Canapé-Vert appointment protest reported for the same date?
What was the end date and state response?

title: Fort-National residents’ protest for police resources and security
organizer: Residents from Fort-National; no named organizer
threshold_50_evidence: Neither opened account gives a count or qualitative threshold estimate; ≥50 unknown.

occurrence.summary: Télépluriel says residents went into the streets on 19 Dec; Miroirinfo’s 21 Dec roundup reports a Fort-National demonstration on that date.

start_date.summary: Télépluriel’s 20 Dec article says “yesterday”; Miroirinfo explicitly gives Thursday 19 Dec.

organizer.summary: Residents of the neighborhood are identified; no formal organizer named.

participants.summary: No count or qualitative estimate in either account.

threshold_50.summary: Unknown; two reports do not establish ≥50 simultaneously.

state_target.summary: Residents asked authorities to provide police more resources and act against gangs/insecurity.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; neither account establishes participant violence.

state_response.summary: Unknown; no state response to the event reported.

notes: The two bodies describe the same date/place/action, but story lineage is not known; do not claim independent corroboration. Attendance remains unknown.
open_questions: Were the two reports independently gathered or one story lineage?
How many residents were present at the Fort-National street gathering at one time?
Did the action continue beyond 19 December and what was the state response?
